[HIGH] REST_GATE_BAN_ENTERED
subject: SYSTEM
reason: IP_BAN_418
at: 2026-10-09T03:00:00Z
until: 2026-10-09T03:15:00Z
What happened: The exchange banned the requests of this system (HTTP 418) and the REST gate now refuses every REST call before it is sent (REST_GATE_BAN_ENTERED, IP_BAN_418). The until line of the header is the gate's own end time of the ban.
Position: A position may be open, with or without a stop. While the ban lasts the system cannot read it or change it through REST.
System already did: Until that time no REST call leaves the system, so nothing reaches the exchange meanwhile. The end time is saved, so a restart keeps the ban. A placement is never re-sent.
You must: Check the exchange position and its stop yourself now, and close or protect the position if it needs it. Start no other traffic to the exchange from this address until the until time has passed.
